2Baba Sparks Reactions After Using Annie’s ‘Rainbow’ to Tease New Album
results.description: Sola Benson Legendary Nigerian singer Innocent Idibia, popularly known as 2Baba or Tubaba, has stirred fresh conversations online after using a song associated with his former wife, Annie Macaulay-Idibia, to announce his forthcoming album. The music icon took to social media to reveal that his next body of work, titled Oldest Young Man , is in the works, accompanying the announcement with a reflective message about his journey and resilience. “I’ve lived it. I’ve seen it. I’m still here. My new album, Oldest Young Man, soon to come,” Tubaba wrote. While the announcement itself generated interest among his followers, it was the choice of background music that drew particular attention. 2Baba used Rainbow , a song he famously sang for Annie, as the soundtrack to the post. The choice immediately prompted reactions from social media users, with some interpreting it as a possible emotional reference to his past relationship with the actress. The singer did not explain the reason behind his choice of song or indicate that the post was specifically directed at Annie. However, fans quickly began attaching their own meanings to the combination of his message, the song and the title of his forthcoming album. One Instagram user, eje_bailo_ejeh, tagged Annie and wrote, “Come home. We no go go again. I know my guy well to understand this is for you.” Another user, kallystouch, reacted emotionally to the song, writing, “Eya. This song tells a story, love you legendary.” For some followers, the post appeared to represent a moment of reflection following the singer's highly publicised personal experiences. One commenter, nwannewuihejudith, wrote, “Sometimes you just have to let go, to find yourself. And for them to realise their worth.” Another Instagram user, kenjne_001, declared, “You and Annie na soulmate.” A further reaction from blessingok read, “He went to hell and back. Now it makes sense.” The reactions underline the continued public interest in 2Baba and Annie’s relationship, even after their marriage came to an end. The pair, who had been married for several years, became one of Nigeria’s most recognisable celebrity couples, with their relationship frequently attracting public attention. Beyond the personal interpretations surrounding the post, the announcement also signals a new musical chapter for 2Baba, one of the most enduring figures in Nigeria’s contemporary music scene. With Oldest Young Man , the singer appears poised to reflect on the experiences that have shaped his journey, judging from his words: “I’ve lived it. I’ve seen it. I’m still here.” For now, however, the use of Rainbow has ensured that the album announcement is being discussed not only as a musical comeback or new project, but also through the lens of one of the most closely followed chapters of the singer’s personal life.
